scripts.bootstrap: pnpm -C backend install && pnpm -C frontend install
scripts.dev: pnpm -C backend dev & pnpm -C frontend dev & wait
scripts.test: pnpm -C backend test && pnpm -C frontend test
scripts.build: pnpm -C frontend build && pnpm -C backend build
scripts.verify: pnpm -C backend verify && pnpm -C frontend verify
